title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. translated_title: LimeTree：基于树图的线性内存图神经网络，用于资源高效的语言建模与上下文外推
translated_abstract: 近年来，寻找Transformer计算高效替代方案的研究催生了众多架构；然而，大多数架构在联想回忆（如键值检索）和长度外推方面存在严重缺陷，即使是标准Transformer在这些任务上也表现挣扎。本文提出了LimeTree，这是一种在内存和计算两方面均具有线性复杂度的序列建模架构。通过将合成的KV检索任务直接集成到标准语言建模训练中，LimeTree在实现较低困惑度的同时保持了可靠的召回能力。在严格的计算约束下，论文评估了该架构的两个变体在WikiText-103和PG-19数据集上的表现。在WikiText-103上，LimeTree仅在四块Quadro RTX 8000 GPU上训练6小时即达到19的token级困惑度，并且即使从512的训练上下文长度外推至16,384的评估长度，仍保持100%的KV检索准确率。在PG-19上，该模型达到了token级的困惑度……
tldr: LimeTree是一种内存与计算均为线性复杂度的树图语言模型架构，通过在语言建模训练中集成KV检索任务，仅用极低的计算成本（4块GPU训练6小时）便实现了19的低困惑度，并能将上下文从512外推至16,384个token且保持100%的检索准确率。
en_tdlr: LimeTree is a linear-memory, linear-compute tree-graph language model architecture that integrates KV retrieval tasks into training, achieving a perplexity of 19 with minimal compute (6 hours on 4 GPUs) while maintaining 100% retrieval accuracy when extrapolating context from 512 to 16,384 tokens.
